newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Reynolds says six-mth net up sharply.
newsitem.headline: Reynolds says six-mth net up sharply.

text.p: Reynolds Philippine Corp said on Tuesday its first half operating net income soared 83 percent to 60 million pesos from 32.8 million a year ago.
The aluminium manufacturer told the Philippine Stock Exchange the higher income was due to the hefty increase in sales volume which reached 6,980 tonnes during the period against 5,287 tonnes.
The company reported a record net income last year when it earned 190 million pesos, up 77 percent from 107 million posted the previous year.
The company has been modernising its operation, improving its gross profit margin to 19.4 percent in 1996 from 14.9 percent in 1995.
At the same time, Reynolds said it was not yet keen on investing in a polyethylene manufacturing plant to be set up together with British Petroleum Co and Petronas of Malaysia.

"The management is not yet prepared to recommend any specific proposal to invest at this point in time until after the completion of the feasibility study and further evaluation have been concluded," it added.

In its recent shareholders' meeting, the shareholders also passed a resolution allowing the company to issue guaranty or surety bonds in favour of its subsidiaries for them to be able to secure loans to finance their respective projects.
